Usage: qoderwake [options] [command]

QoderWake local CLI and daemon

Options:
  -v, --version            display version

Commands:
  start [options]          start daemon background process
  stop [options]           stop daemon
  restart [options]        restart daemon
  status [options]         show daemon status
  readiness [options]      check cloud computer runtime readiness
  portal [options]         open the local QoderWake Console in your default
                           browser
  config                   manage config
  proxy                    manage local network proxy without signing in
  settings                 manage user settings
  storage                  manage storage backends
  backup                   manage local pre-upgrade backups
  plugin                   manage qoderwake plugins
  waker                    manage wakers
  local                    current-device resources
  project                  manage projects
  mcp                      manage waker MCP servers
  skill                    manage waker skills
  permission               manage local waker permissions
  channel                  manage IM channels
  extension                inspect local extension runtime
  session                  manage sessions
  group                    manage groups
  sop                      diagnose and manage the system SOP catalog
  messages                 read and send conversation messages
  atwaker                  use the external IM task bound to this Group Run
  todo                     manage this Waker's todos in the active group
                           Conversation
  goal                     inspect or update the active group Conversation Goal
  runs                     inspect and cancel conversation runs
  trace                    inspect task lifecycle traces
  automation               manage Waker automatic tasks and create WakerFlow
                           automatic tasks
  memory                   inspect and maintain qoderwake memory
  login [options]          authenticate with Qoder
  logout                   log out and clear credentials
  whoami                   show current logged-in user
  version                  print version and platform information

  log [options] [traceId]  query or follow qoderwake logs
  feedback [options]       upload local qoderwake logs as a feedback report
  teams                    inspect Teams runtime data
  workflow                 manage workflows (WakerFlow)
  models                   list available models
  account                  account profile, plan, usage and activity
  connector                inspect connector marketplace and bundled runtimes
  board                    inspect Task Board work records

  knowledge                QMind knowledge base

Usage: qoderwake start [options]

start daemon background process

Options:
  --host <host>   listen host
  --port <port>   listen port or auto (default: "19820")
  --foreground    run daemon in foreground
  --open          open browser after daemon starts
  --no-keepalive  start detached daemon without registering OS keepalive service
  --mock          use embedded mock gateway without login (foreground only)
  -y, --yes       confirm external network exposure without an interactive
                  prompt
  -h, --help      display help for command

Usage: qoderwake stop [options]

stop daemon

Options:
  --force         force stop with SIGKILL
  --no-keepalive  stop daemon without querying OS keepalive service
  -h, --help      display help for command

Usage: qoderwake restart [options]

restart daemon

Options:
  --host <host>   listen host
  --port <port>   listen port or auto (default: "19820")
  --foreground    run daemon in foreground
  --open          open browser after daemon starts
  --no-keepalive  restart detached daemon without registering OS keepalive
                  service
  --force         confirm restart even when the replacement will run local-only
  -y, --yes       confirm external network exposure without an interactive
                  prompt
  -h, --help      display help for command
